column1: # THE REGISTERED CREDENTIAL MINTS (BUILD-DELTA #36): each pins the digest of its REGION, the smallest expression,
# statement or block of the minting function holding every draw clippy reports there and every literal carrying its
# prefix (- = none). A change to how the credential is built from its draw changes the digest and re-opens the review.

column6: per-boot internal dispatch secret: two UUIDv4, process memory only
env-ops capability lease bearer: 32 OsRng bytes, hex
editor runtime connection token (BUILD-DELTA #31(c)): hex of 32 OsRng bytes, no prefix
bootstrap, session, SCIM and invite tokens: two UUIDv4 behind one primitive
OAuth state, nonce and PKCE verifier: the thread CSPRNG
GitHub App JWT: SIGNED with the App private key (RS256), not random; its secrecy is the key's
managed backup export download token: UUIDv4, stored as a hash
automation webhook trigger token: two UUIDv4
workload effect capability token (32 OsRng bytes) and its one-way id
model-mount capability token: 32 OsRng bytes, id drawn separately
Google OAuth state and PKCE verifier primitive: the thread CSPRNG
Google OAuth state (24 bytes) and PKCE code_verifier (48 bytes) from that primitive
